 Introduction 
 Patrick 
Today's episode requires a slightly longer introduction to make a few things extremely clear to anyone listening. It's a conversation with Lior Susan, the founder of Eclipse Ventures, whose mission is to unlock solutions to age-old physical industry problems through the intersection of bits and atoms. Lior is Israeli and served in Israel's special forces before founding Eclipse.

 The topic of today's conversation is one fellow investor's perspective on the terror attacks of October 7th and the path forward. I hope it goes without saying that my personal stance on this situation is to yearn for peace. I hope more than anything that collective action is in the direction of fewer people dying and most importantly, fewer and ideally zero innocent civilians dying in Israel and in Gaza and Palestine.
